test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The work inscribed on the tomb in the memory of the person
solution:
The correct answer is 'Epitaph'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The most appropriate one-word substitute for '**The work inscribed on the tomb in the memory of the person**' is 'Epitaph'.
 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• ​Epigraph- *an inscription on a building, statue, or coin.*
 
• Excerpt- *a short extract from a film, broadcast, or piece of music or writing.*
 
• Euphoria- *a feeling or state of intense excitement and happiness.*
